definition.en: The attachment of a muscle that usually stays still. With a foot planted on the ground, the end that actually moves can swap.
definition.zh: 肌肉通常不动的那一端附着。脚踩在地上时，实际在动的一端可能对调。

definition.en: The attachment of a muscle that is usually pulled towards the other end when the muscle shortens.
definition.zh: 肌肉收缩时通常被拉向另一端的那一端附着。

definition.en: Sheets and bands of connective tissue around muscles. The iliotibial tract is a thickened band of fascia; it cannot contract.
definition.zh: 包在肌肉外面的结缔组织膜或带。髂胫束就是一条增厚的筋膜，它不会收缩。

definition.en: The four-headed muscle at the front of the thigh that extends the knee; rectus femoris also crosses the hip.
definition.zh: 大腿前方伸膝的四头肌，股直肌还跨过髋关节。

definition.en: The posterior-thigh group: semitendinosus, semimembranosus and biceps femoris. The short biceps head crosses only the knee.
definition.zh: 大腿后方肌群，包括半腱肌、半膜肌和股二头肌；股二头肌短头只跨膝。

definition.en: A muscle crossing two joints, so its length depends on the positions of both.
definition.zh: 跨过两个关节的肌肉，长度同时受两个关节位置影响。

definition.en: The strong band from the kneecap to the front of the tibia that carries the pull of the quadriceps.
definition.zh: 从髌骨到胫骨前面的一条坚韧的带，传递股四头肌的拉力。

definition.en: Latin for "goose foot": where the tendons of sartorius, gracilis and semitendinosus spread out on the upper inner tibia.
definition.zh: 意思是“鹅的脚”：缝匠肌、股薄肌和半腱肌的肌腱在胫骨上端内侧散开附着的地方。

definition.en: Pointing the foot down at the ankle, as when raising the heel while the forefoot stays planted.
definition.zh: 踝部让脚向下指的动作，例如前脚掌踩地时抬起脚跟。

definition.en: Drawing the top of the foot towards the shin, as when lifting the forefoot with the heel down.
definition.zh: 足背靠近小腿前方的动作，例如脚跟留地时抬起前脚掌。

definition.en: The part of a movement in which a muscle keeps working while it lengthens, such as slowly lowering the forefoot.
definition.zh: 动作中肌肉一边用力一边被拉长的阶段，例如慢慢放下前脚掌。

definition.en: A strong cord of connective tissue that carries a muscle's pull to a bone.
definition.zh: 把肌肉的拉力传到骨上的一束坚韧结缔组织。

definition.en: Bending and straightening mainly at the hips while the back stays steady, as in a Romanian deadlift.
definition.zh: 主要在髋部弯曲和伸直、背部保持稳定的动作方式，例如罗马尼亚硬拉。

definition.en: Electromyography: recording the electrical activity of a muscle. A higher reading does not show that the muscle is producing more force or will grow more.
definition.zh: 肌电图：记录肌肉的电活动。读数更高，并不说明肌肉出力更大，也不说明它会长得更多。
